The axial length was 30.0 mm
a yellowish oval lesion within a wide area of chorioretinal atrophy

The sclera was approximately one-third thinner (98, 77, and 50 μm for the pit's floor, temporal wall, and nasal wall, respectively)
The choroid was obliterated
Width and depth of 522 × 536 μm
Autofluorescence imaging: The pit had a homogeneous low autofluorescence
Fluorescein angiography: Showed a branch of a posterior ciliary artery near the lesion
The pit was slightly hyperfluorescent in the late frames
